dataset.name: Westerscheldetunnel toll
dataset.method: Tunnelwet Westerschelde: N.V. Westerscheldetunnel's tariffs per passage, by the whole vehicle's length and height: category 3 (under 12 m, over 3 m high) and 4 (over 12 m), the standard price, with `etc` the T-Tag price. Trucks over 3.5 t are taken to be over 3 m high. Cars and vans pay nothing since 30 December 2024; trucks still pay. The page names no date: the prices are those it published when fetched.
dataset.publisher: carbon-cost (majidkabir/carbon-cost), compiled from the sources listed

vehicles.description: Vehicles over 3 m high (here: trucks over 3.5 t), by length

network.description: The Westerscheldetunnel (N62 Terneuzen-Ellewoutsdijk), charged at its toll plaza either way.

tax.note: Not recorded as a field in the source table; dataset.method says where the sources state it.
